failedAssertions.reason: Staff availability ignores special days. GET /operator/reservations/book/availability returned 141 slots on two days marked closed/online_closed and POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations created a reservation (201) on a closed day, while public availability correctly answered closed/online_closed for the same days.

The App booking sheet offers and books slots on a closed day (staff availability ignores special days, same root cause as VAL-ONLINE-007); a custom-service slot showed no closed-day warning, the pacing limit produced a generic error banner instead of the documented warning, and an overbook booking succeeded without a pacing warning. Public Sites correctly showed the day as closed.

Staff availability is hold-blind: with a live guest hold on the slot (G9-2, 2026-11-15 12:00), GET /operator/reservations/book/availability still returned the slot with available:true and suggestedTableIds, both unscoped and scoped to the held area. The staff day feed lists the live hold and the booking write path respects holds, so the gap is confined to the availability read.

The manage link inside the confirmation email and SMS is an App-origin URL (http://localhost:3001/reserve/manage#t=...) that 404s (browser renders the App "Page not found" page); the same link opened at the Sites origin renders the manage view and /reservations/manage/ics returns 200. The contract lists a 404ing manage link as a fail condition. All other checkpoints passed (message kinds, operator history with the guest modification, the cancelled slot reopening).

Same manage-link origin defect as VAL-CROSS-011: the manage link captured in the email is an App-origin URL that 404s. The manage page itself works when opened at the Sites origin with the token (shows guest, date, party, status) and the .ics endpoint returns text/calendar.

The App report builder does not offer the bookings or waitlist_entries subjects (screenshot of the subject dropdown), while GET /acme/reports/token for the same admin lists both. All three App report routes filter the catalog with catalogForGrants(fullCatalog, staff.subjects) - staffing grants only (apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reports+/new.tsx:35, _index.tsx:38, $reportId.tsx:48).

documentedDeviations.note: Second conversion attempt with the same hold token answered 410 hold_expired (the contract only requires that it fail).

The contract's literal second step (same booking body, fresh Idempotency-Key) answers 410 hold_expired because the hold token was consumed by the successful booking; the expected 409 slot_unavailable + alternatives is produced by a fresh hold attempt for the exhausted unit, which was verified. Marked pass on behavior; the literal wording mismatch is recorded here rather than hidden.

The single-unit slot was constructed for the test (Main Dining block attempt 409ed on the known block/reflow defect, so the m3+m4 combo was occupied with two staff bookings instead; G10-T1..T6, T11 were already occupied by this group's fills), then the hold took the only remaining unit (G10-T12) and the staff overbook took it.
The contract's literal guest_modify_cutoff_min value 100000 exceeds the settings schema maximum (10_080), so the observable requirements were reproduced with 10080 and a booking inside the cutoff.

The waitlist-off half was verified end to end (no Notify me / Join waitlist controls); for the alternatives half the API payload was verified because the same-day alternatives branch cannot render (flow.ts branch order, already documented by scrutiny) and no day could be exhausted from the UI.

appliedUpdates.description: Added the "Round: guest-channels-and-crm user testing" block: environment state (ports, seeded orgs, baseline settings), a 21-row data-isolation registry, isolation rules, Flow Validator Guidance for the agent-browser / curl / terminal / mixed surfaces, common recipes (token minting, mock transports, dev email capture, tenant DB paths), and the concurrency plan.

Runtime findings, batches A-C: every local client hashes to the same client IP, so the durable book_ip (20/day) and holds_ip (10/10min) buckets are shared; curl groups must send private X-Forwarded-For values and the parent cleared the shared rsv_rate_counters rows in both tenant DBs. Also recorded: the manage-link origin defect, the POST /reservations/requests raw 409 leak when a pending request holds a table, leftover special days/blocks on earlier registry dates, and hydration console noise.

Runtime findings, batches D-G plus the g2b retest: operator block creation 409s when it overlaps existing reservations (block/reflow defect), staff availability ignores special days, max_parties pacing and live holds; the report builder's staffing-only catalog filter; the recipe for forcing a single-unit slot (occupy every fitting table or block the area, then hold the last one) used to re-test VAL-ONLINE-016.

notes: First user-testing round for this milestone. 181 assertions were tested by 21 flow-validator groups across browser, curl, terminal and mixed surfaces; VAL-REPORT-024 was independently reported by two groups (both pass). The four assertions blocked in an earlier batch by the shared rate-limit bucket (VAL-ONLINE-013/014/016/040) were re-tested and pass. Environment: tenant-api US 3007, tenant-api KSA 3009, App 3001, Sites 3008, acme and riyadh-grill seeded, all four reservations.* flags true; acme large_party_mode=request (round baseline) and all settings mutated during the round were restored by their groups.
